intro: Between April and May 2026, ZCyberNews published 11 articles on SQL injection vulnerabilities, with the most severe being CVE-2026-27681 (CVSS 9.9), followed by CVE-2026-36962, CVE-2026-42208, and CVE-2026-6433 (all CVSS 9.8), and CVE-2026-34259 (CVSS 9.6). The coverage spanned enterprise software, web hosting, e-commerce, retail, and software development sectors globally, with a severity mix of three high, seven critical, and one medium.
